title: Today shows two different birthday counts, and the tile's 'Send a wish' includes members the automatic wish already reaches
what: On Today the 'Birthdays today' tile counts every birthday and says 'Send a wish'. Tapping it opens the members list with 'WhatsApp all N, one by one' and a birthday message for all of them. Lower on the same page, 'Messages to send' counts only the members the automatic birthday wish will not reach. So the owner sees, say, 5 and 2 for the same day, and the tile leads him to send a second wish to the 3 who already got one on their phone.
expected: The tile and the row agree, or the tile says how many get the automatic wish, and the WhatsApp-all list leaves out members it reaches.
how_often: every day with a birthday, when the automatic wish is on
fix_line: Count and list only the birthdays the automatic wish will not reach, as the row below already does

title: Today asks the owner to remind members whose plans end, with no word that the automatic reminder already does it
what: Today shows '5 plans end this week' with a 'Remind them' button, and tiles 'Ending in 1-3 days: Renew them now' and 'Ending in 4-7 days: Remind them this week' that open a 'WhatsApp all, one by one' list. The automatic 'Plan ends soon' and 'Plan ends today' reminders are on by default and already go 7 and 3 days before and on the last day to members with the app. Nothing on Today says which members already got one, so app members get the same reminder twice. Birthdays got this fix; plans ending did not.
expected: Today counts and lists only the members the automatic reminder will not reach, or says how many it already reaches.
fix_line: Leave out of the ending count and list the members the automatic reminder reaches, as the birthday row does

title: Messaging a member from Today's 'Talk to these members' leaves them on the list with no sign anyone did
what: Each row in 'Talk to these members' has a Message link that only opens WhatsApp. Nothing is saved. The member stays on the list until they renew, with no 'messaged today' mark, so the owner, a second desk person or the same person tomorrow cannot tell who was already contacted and may message the same member again.
expected: A tap on Message is remembered for the gym (on the server) and the row shows 'messaged today, by whom'.
fix_line: Save a 'messaged' note on the server when Message is tapped and show it on the row

title: After a trainer replies to a member question, nobody can see whether the member saw it
what: Replying on Member questions sends the member a phone pop-up by itself. The card then shows only who replied and when. Unlike Member messages, which says 'read by the member' or 'not read yet', there is no read mark and no word that the pop-up could not go (no app link, notifications off, an iPhone). The trainer believes the member was told and does not follow up.
expected: The question card shows 'seen by the member' or 'not seen yet', as Member messages does.
fix_line: Keep and show a 'seen by the member' mark on answered questions, as Member messages does
